decision.explanation: The original sources directly state that Anna Palaiologina was married to John II Orsini (D1S1, D4S1) and later to John Komnenos Asen (D1S2, D4S11). These are distinct valid referents and complementary answers. Other candidates like Manuel II Palaiologos, Thomas Preljubović, John VIII Palaiologos, and Andronikos III Palaiologos are either unrelated to Anna Palaiologina or refer to other individuals with similar names.
